user.title: UGREEN Connect
user.description: Sign in with the same account you use in the UgreenConnect app. Pick the region your account was registered in — accounts are not shared between regions.

data.debug_dump: Write a raw cloud snapshot to the config folder

data_description.nominal_voltage: Used only to read a session's watt-hours back as milliamp-hours. 3.85 V is the nominal cell voltage of phones, earbuds and handhelds; a laptop's pack is far higher, and its milliamp-hour figure means nothing until this matches it.
data_description.efficiency: How much of what leaves the port reaches the cell. The rest becomes heat in the cable and the device's own converter.
data_description.session_idle_end: How long a port must deliver nothing before its charging session is called finished and the next one may start. The charger keeps a port live for a bare cable, so this is the only thing that can end a session. Long enough that a phone topping itself up at 100% stays one session; shorter if you swap devices on the same cable within a couple of hours.
data_description.debug_dump: Saves ugreen_connect_debug.json once per restart. Useful while the integration is still being built out; safe to turn off later.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate UGREEN Connect
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} was rejected. Enter it again.

chargers.title: Chargers on this account
chargers.description: Tick the chargers to add. Each is read as its own model, which the account says, and the dashboard switches between them. The rest can be added later under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the UGREEN cloud.
error.invalid_auth: The account or password was rejected.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

set_wallpaper.name: Set wallpaper
set_wallpaper.description: Upload a picture and show it on the charger's screen. It is cropped to 560x170 from the centre; the card lets you choose the crop yourself.

device_id.name: Charger
device_id.description: Which charger to send the picture to.

path.name: File
path.description: Path to an image on the Home Assistant host, e.g. /config/www/desk.jpg.

url.name: URL
url.description: Address of an image to fetch and upload.

image.name: Image data
image.description: The picture itself, base64 encoded, with or without a data: prefix.

data.debug_dump: Write a raw cloud snapshot to the config folder

data_description.scan_interval: How often a reading arrives. Measured start to start, so the wait for the charger to answer comes out of this rather than being added to it. 5 s keeps the wattage live; raise it to lean less on UGREEN's servers.
data_description.region: Only change this if the account itself was moved to another server. The password is checked against the new region before the change is kept.
data_description.debug_dump: Saves ugreen_connect_debug.json on every refresh. It is the unedited cloud payload.
data_description.nominal_voltage: Used only to read a session's watt-hours back as milliamp-hours. 3.85 V is the nominal cell voltage of phones, earbuds and handhelds; a laptop's pack is far higher, and its milliamp-hour figure means nothing until this matches it.
data_description.efficiency: How much of what leaves the port reaches the cell. The rest becomes heat in the cable and the device's own converter.
data_description.session_idle_end: How long a port must deliver nothing before its charging session is called finished and the next one may start. The charger keeps a port live for a bare cable, so this is the only thing that can end a session. Long enough that a phone topping itself up at 100% stays one session; shorter if you swap devices on the same cable within a couple of hours.
data_description.chargers: The chargers on this account that Home Assistant polls and shows. Unticking one removes its device and entities; ticking it again brings them back.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the UGREEN cloud.
error.invalid_auth: The account or password was rejected in that region.

not_writable_on_model.message: Setting this has not been verified on the {model}, so it is shown but not written. Its value can be changed in the UGREEN app.

mode_not_selectable.message: Custom can only be set in the UgreenConnect app. Home Assistant sets the presets; the Custom mode is configured and chosen in the app's own editor.

priority_not_running.message: The charger is not in Priority, so which ports it charges first cannot be set. Choose Priority first.

priority_needs_a_port.message: At least one port has to be charged first in Priority. Turn another one on before turning this one off.

dc_turbo_not_running.message: The charger is not in DC turbo, so the DC port's settings cannot be changed. Choose DC turbo first.

port_output_app_only.message: The 160W's ports are switched on and off in the UGREEN app for now. Home Assistant shows them but does not set them yet.

firmware_version_unknown.message: The charger has not reported its firmware version yet. Try again in a minute.

firmware_check_failed.message: Could not ask the UGREEN cloud for the firmware file: {error}

firmware_current.message: The UGREEN cloud no longer offers newer firmware for this charger.

firmware_failed.message: The charger reported that the firmware update failed. It keeps running the version it had.

firmware_unconfirmed.message: The charger did not confirm the firmware update. Check its firmware version in a few minutes; if it has not changed, try again.

new_charger.title: A new charger is on your UGREEN account
new_charger.description: {names} is on your UGREEN account but not in Home Assistant yet. To add it, open Settings → Devices & Services → UGREEN Connect → Configure and tick it. Saving without it makes this message go away.
